development_objective: Fit free-running speed against lap 13 on a uniform fractional distance grid and sector durations at fixed development-derived boundaries. Include weak regularisation about engineering starting values. Keep mass, electrical power, efficiency and energy budgets fixed. Conditional unknown deployment represented by a constant quarter request. DRS zones are a fixed distance lookup derived only from the development lap. Validate the fast fit integrator against exact finite-battery event replays. Stop after one fit. Holdout target speeds do not enter the simulator.
diagnostics: Report signed lap/sector time errors and distance-weighted speed RMSE, observed braking, corner-exit and throttle/DRS residuals, and the change from the historical best schedule. The historical trace is rotated by the independently located start line.
claim: All held-out laps must meet the empirical criteria. These are practical dissertation thresholds, not measurement confidence intervals. A failure permits only a conditional map and must be reported by criterion. No fitting to the pole or protected RQ3 events.
zone_sensitivities: Scale both lateral acceleration terms together by 0.95 and 1.05. These local grip/aero scenarios test robustness of zone choices and are not a statistical parameter range.
